name: LWC Test: Daily Multi-Indicator
description: LWC chart integration test. Exercises candlestick, lines (SMA/EMA/Bollinger), plotbands (RSI zones), reference lines, and multi-pane layout.
source:
# =============================================================================
# LWC TEST: DAILY MULTI-INDICATOR RESEARCH
# Tests: Candlestick, Line overlays, PlotBands, HLines, Multi-pane
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
open_price = src.o

# === MOVING AVERAGES (Line overlays on price pane) ===
sma_20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)
ema_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.ema)(close)

# === BOLLINGER BANDS ===
bb = bbands(period=20, stddev=2)(close)

# === RSI (Separate pane with plotbands) ===
rsi_val = rsi(period=14)(close)

# === MACD (Separate pane with histogram + zero line) ===
macd_out = macd(short_period=12, long_period=26, signal_period=9)(close)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- Bollinger Bands on price pane (3 lines) ---
xy_lines(
    title='Bollinger Bands (20, 2)',
    category='Price',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BB Upper', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BB Lower', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BB Middle', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(bb.bbands_upper, bb.bbands_lower, bb.bbands_middle))

# --- SMA/EMA on price pane ---
xy_lines(
    title='Moving Averages',
    category='Price',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 20', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EMA 50', color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(sma_20, ema_50))

# --- RSI in separate pane with plotbands ---
xy_lines(
    title='RSI (14)',
    category='RSI',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='RSI', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0, to=30, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Oversold'),
        PlotBand(from=70, to=100, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.1, label='Overbought')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=50.0, title='Midline', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=rsi_val)

# --- MACD lines in separate pane ---
xy_lines(
    title='MACD (12, 26, 9)',
    category='MACD',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='MACD', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Signal', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Histogram', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(macd_out.macd, macd_out.macd_signal, macd_out.macd_histogram))
